heading: Today
text: Some morning clouds, especially north, giving way to increasing sunshine, and becoming mostly sunny south. Chilly. Highs from 50 to 60 north to south.  Northwest winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph early, diminishing from the north to less than 10 mph in the afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy in the evening, then cloudy.  Showers developing through NY toward midnight, reaching NH by morning.  Lows in the 30s, near 32 far northeast.  Winds light, turning to the east and southeast near 10 mph.

heading: Friday
text: Rain and showers spreading east, diminishing to showers.   Windy and milder.  Highs in the 50s to near 60 north, 60s in the Champlain Valley and south.  Winds becoming south to southeast 10 to 25 mph, gusting 20 to 40 mph, strongest through the Champlain Valley and the northern slopes.
